text: How does a tiny sharpener make such a perfect point?
Inside is a hole shaped like a cone, with a blade along one side.
Twist the pencil, and the blade shaves a thin strip of wood.
The pencil only slides deeper once the wood fits the cone.
So turn after turn, the wood becomes the cone, with the lead at the very tip.
The hole is a cone. The blade shaves until the pencil matches it.
